answer.value: Child safety: data filtering used as a pre-training method to mitigate Child Safety risk. Safety fine-tuning data: human-generated data from vendors combined with synthetic data, and LLM-based classifiers used to select high-quality prompts and responses. Safety data responses were modified to follow tone guidelines.
quotes: We leverage pre-training methods like data filtering as a first step in mitigating Child Safety risk in our model.

We employ a multi-faceted approach to data collection, combining human-generated data from our vendors with synthetic data to mitigate potential safety risks. We’ve developed many large language model (LLM)-based classifiers that enable us to thoughtfully select high-quality prompts and responses, enhancing data quality control.
We included both borderline and adversarial prompts in our safety data strategy, and modified our safety data responses to follow tone guidelines.
